title: Plan: House systems
description:
Port swehouse.c (~3143 lines). 24 house systems.

## Core trig (catalogue-internal §14.1)
- `Asc1(x, f, sine, cose)` — quadrant-aware wrapper normalizing RA to [0°,90°], delegates to Asc2()
- `Asc2(x, f, sine, cose)` — oblique spherical trig: cot(λ) = (−tan(f)×sin(ε) + cos(ε)×cos(x))/sin(x)
- `AscDash(x, f, sine, cose)` — derivative dλ/dt for cusp speed

## Ascendant & MC
- MC: tan(MC) = tan(ARMC)/cos(ε)
- Ascendant: Asc1(ARMC + 90°, lat, sin(ε), cos(ε))

## House systems — key algorithms (catalogue-internal §14.3)
- **Placidus** (default): semi-arc division, iterative Newton-Raphson (max 100 iter). Fails at polar latitudes.
- **Koch**: single pole height, interpolation between meridian and horizon
- **Regiomontanus**: fixed pole heights, no iteration
- **Campanus**: prime vertical pole heights
- **Topocentric/Polich-Page**: fh = arctan(tan(lat)/3), arctan(2tan(lat)/3)
- **Alcabitius**: semi-diurnal/nocturnal arc division
- **Equal/Whole Sign/Porphyry**: simple arithmetic
- **Gauquelin 36**: Placidus-like iteration for 36 division points
- **Meridian/Axial**: equatorial intervals projected through ecliptic pole

## Special points (catalogue-internal §14.4)
Vertex, Equatorial Ascendant, Co-Ascendant (Koch/Munkasey), Polar Ascendant

## Speed computation
Most: analytical via AscDash(). Complex systems (Sunshine, APC, Pullen): finite differences.

- Edge case: polar latitudes where Placidus/Koch fail

execution_record:
Decomposed into 9 implement sub-tasks (swisseph-rs/59–67) on arc ~11, phase=implement, each ready-for-agent/AFK with full Sonnet-executable specs. Produced docs/c-ref-houses.md (1391 lines) covering all of swehouse.c.

Corrections to the original (pre-architecture) description:
- **Stateless / no global state**: the original sketch `compute_houses(armc, lat, obliquity, system)` is refined into a pure stateless `houses::houses_armc(armc, geolat, eps, hsys, sundec: Option<f64>) -> Result<HouseResult>` PLUS `Ephemeris::houses/houses_ex/houses_ex2` wrapper methods (date→armc/eps/sun-dec). The C `static double saved_sundec` cache and the `ascmc[9]==99` sentinel are explicitly NOT replicated — Sun declination is threaded through as an explicit required param for Sunshine.
- **Speed mechanism is non-uniform** (original said "most analytical, complex=finite-diff"). Actual: special-point speeds (ac/mc/armc/vertex/equasc/coasc1/coasc2/polasc) are ALWAYS analytical (AscDash). Cusp speeds split 3 ways: (a) analytical-inline for P/G/C/H/J/K/R/T + linear-rate for O + ac/mc-copy for A/E/V/D; (b) driver-level central finite-difference (1-sec armc step) for I/i/L/Q/S/X/M/F/Y (the `do_interpol` flag); (c) NEITHER — B/N/U/W leave most cusp_speeds at 0 or a stale ac/mc value, which must be replicated bit-exactly, not "fixed". This drove the slicing.
- **Dependencies already satisfied**: HouseSystem enum (25 variants incl. SunshineAlt) already exists in types.rs; `armc_to_mc` already ported in math.rs (fixstar work); sidereal_time + obliquity + nutation + ayanamsa + calc_ut all available — so the original "Phase 0/Phase 3" deps are met.
- **swe_gauquelin_sector** lives in swecl.c (not swehouse.c). imeth 0/1 (geometric, via house_pos 'G') is in scope (sub-task 66); imeth 2–5 (rise/set) deferred — depend on the not-yet-ported rise_trans module.
- **Sidereal houses**: traditional subtract-ayanamsa mode in the wrapper task (65); the two geometric projection modes (ECL_T0, SSY_PLANE) split into sub-task 67.
- HouseResult uses `cusps: [f64;37]` (C-faithful; Gauquelin fills [1..=36], others [1..=12]).

Slicing: 59 scaffold+core-trig+driver+angles+special-points+Equal-family; 60 O/S/X/M/F (+Porphyry fallback helper, first finite-diff path); 61 R/C/T/H/J; 62 P/K/G (Newton); 63 U/Y/L/Q; 64 Sunshine I/i; 65 Ephemeris UT wrappers + trad sidereal; 66 house_pos + gauquelin_sector(0/1); 67 sidereal ECL_T0/SSY_PLANE. Each sub-task targets ~300–500 Rust lines, names every file/fn, cites c-ref-houses.md sections, and includes a golden gen_houses.c key + Rust test + 1e-8 escape hatch.
